# Nihongo Talk (日本語トーク) — AI Japanese Language & JLPT Preparation Platform

> An open, 100% free comprehensive Japanese language learning ecosystem combining Real-time AI Voice Sensei (Speaking Coach), Spaced Repetition (Anki SM-2) flashcards, complete JLPT N5–N1 curriculum (Kanji, Grammar, Reading, Listening), and Telegram Mini-App integration.

- Website: https://nihon-talk.vercel.app
- Telegram Mini App & Bot: https://t.me/study_plannerr_bot
- Open Source Repository: https://github.com/Farhodoff/nihongo-talk
- Supported Languages: Uzbek (O'zbekcha), Japanese (日本語)

## Core Capabilities & Features

1. **AI Speaking Sensei (Yuki-sensei)**
   - Real-time conversational Japanese dialogue with natural voice synthesis (TTS) and speech recognition (STT).
   - Instant grammar and pronunciation error detection with explanations in Uzbek and Japanese.
   - Situational scenarios: Tokyo restaurant ordering, convenience store (Konbini), train station navigation, university interview, job interview, and free conversation.
   - URL: https://nihon-talk.vercel.app/speaking

2. **JLPT Master Hub (N5 to N1)**
   - Complete coverage of official Japanese Language Proficiency Test levels N5, N4, N3, N2, and N1.
   - 1,000+ interactive Kanji stroke animations, radicals, On'yomi, and Kun'yomi readings.
   - Grammar database with detailed particle guides, sentence pattern breakdowns, and furigana toggles.
   - Official-format 180-point JLPT mock exams with timed sections and score analytics.
   - URL: https://nihon-talk.vercel.app/jlpt

3. **Smart Spaced Repetition (Anki SM-2 Flashcards)**
   - Algorithmic spaced repetition schedule based on SuperMemo SM-2.
   - Preset decks for JLPT N5/N4 core vocabulary, essential Kanji, and conversational survival phrases.
   - Offline-first caching via IndexedDB and automatic cross-device Supabase sync.
   - URL: https://nihon-talk.vercel.app/decks

4. **Telegram Web App (TWA) Mini-App Integration**
   - Seamless 1-tap mobile learning directly inside Telegram without separate app installation.
   - Native Telegram theme sync, haptic vibration feedback, and automated daily study reminders.
   - URL: https://nihon-talk.vercel.app/twa

5. **100% Free Open Educational Model**
   - Zero subscription fees, zero paywalls, zero premium tiers.
   - Full access to all AI models, JLPT mock exams, and personalized study roadmaps is available completely free of charge.
   - URL: https://nihon-talk.vercel.app/pricing

6. **Developer & Partner REST API**
   - Public REST endpoints for vocabulary lookups, JLPT grammar search, and study habit webhooks.
   - URL: https://nihon-talk.vercel.app/developers
